Every page should use a clean and consistent header and footer. These should show information including [FREELANCER_NAME_006] report name, report ID, vehicle group, confidential/restricted status, assessment date, and page number.

This requirement is especially important. [FREELANCER_NAME_006] final report files must remain editable so I can adapt them for individual customers. I need to be able to update [FREELANCER_NAME_006] vehicle registration, assessment date, report ID, vehicle group, security score, risk band, category scores, weaknesses, recommendations, and customer-specific notes.

Please provide editable report templates for RR01, RR02, RR03, and RR04, allowing me to choose [FREELANCER_NAME_006] correct version according to [FREELANCER_NAME_006] customer’s score/risk level.

I need [FREELANCER_NAME_006] finished files to be straightforward to edit and export as a PDF. Canva or PowerPoint might be [FREELANCER_NAME_006] best option, although I’m willing to consider another format if you recommend something more appropriate.
